values.name: Sun State International Trucks, LLC. – Aftermarket Business
values.noticeBody: Visit our Aftermarket Location for all of your truck and trailer repair needs. We specialize in truck equipment repair, roll off cable repair, hydraulic truck equipment repair and much more.

values.heading: Modifications, alterations and the parts behind them.
values.body: If you need to customize or alter your truck or trailer to fit your specific needs, we're here to assist you. Our fabrication and welding shop handles frame alterations, wheelbase changes, body wraps and liftgate repairs, and our parts counter stocks the body, hoist, trailer and A/C lines that keep specialized equipment working.

items.title: Truck bodies
items.body: All-makes new or used body installations and swaps — van, reefer, dump, flatbed, tank and roll-off hoist.

items.title: Liftgates
items.body: New installations, remounts, warranty service and parts replacement for liftgates on trucks and trailers.

items.title: Frame & hydraulics
items.body: Shorten or lengthen, double single rails, driveline work, Huck bolt replacement, PTO and wet-line kits, hydraulic repairs.

items.title: Trailer parts & service
items.body: Aluminum and fiberglass repair, kingpins, landing gear, accessory installation, and Hyundai and all-makes trailer parts.

items.label: E-Z Ride and Silent Drive Lift Axle Parts
A/C Parts from Carrier, MCC, ACT, Transair & Busair

values.heading: Other Sun State locations.
values.body: Visit us at our convenient locations across Central and Southwest Florida.

items.q: Where is the Sun State Aftermarket Business?
items.a: Sun State International Trucks, LLC. – Aftermarket Business is at 7105 East 6th Ave., Tampa, FL 33619, a few minutes from the Adamo Drive dealership. Phone (813) 627-3282, fax (813) 621-8709.

items.q: What are the Aftermarket store hours?
items.a: The store is open 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM Monday through Friday, and closed Saturday and Sunday.

items.q: What does the Aftermarket facility specialize in?
items.a: Truck equipment repair, roll off cable repair and hydraulic truck equipment repair, plus all-makes body installations and swaps, liftgates, body equipment, frame modifications, DPF and DOC cleaning, and all-makes trailer parts and service.

items.q: Which parts lines are stocked here?
items.a: Godwin dump body parts, Galbreath roll-off hoist and hooklift parts, Hyundai and all-makes trailer parts, Capacity yard tractor parts and warranty, E-Z Ride and Silent Drive lift axle parts, and A/C parts from Carrier, MCC, ACT, Transair and Busair.

items.q: Do you offer pickup and delivery?
items.a: Yes. The Aftermarket location offers in-store shopping, in-store pickup and delivery.

items.q: Can you modify a frame without voiding the factory warranty?
items.a: Yes. Frame work includes shortening and lengthening, double single rails, driveline work and Huck bolt replacement to maintain factory warranty on all makes.

values.heading: Tell us what the truck has to do.
values.body: Bring us the body, hoist, liftgate or frame change you need and we'll tell you what it takes, what it costs and how long the unit will be down.
